card.title: Not Until You Explain
card.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.

mechanism: A removes B's reason to leave so B must explain a specific missing hour.
confusable: Unlike general interrogation, A must keep B present and pursue the named contradiction.
comparison: A offers transport to eliminate the bus excuse; the wedding partner demands explanation despite work pressure.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
